        Utah Correctional Facilities include all jails and prisons we currently are able to serve.  We make every effort to meet the spiritual needs of the inmates.  Catholic inmates may receive the sacraments, go to Mass or Communion Service, scripture study, prayer, worship and more depending on the permission of the institution and availability of staff.
